## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. Mixed confirmations: SPY CORRECTION (1W: -1.96% | 1M: +2.03%) and XLK CORRECTION (1W: -4.02% | 1M: +1.57%) vs VXX BELOW TREND (1W: -2.19% | 1M: -10.95%) — conflicting signals support a neutral stance.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Fear easing but mixed: VXX (1W: -2.19% | 1M: -10.95%) ↓ falling | BELOW TREND, while credit is flat: HYG (1W: -0.29% | 1M: +0.54%) → flat | CORRECTION and LQD (1W: -0.46% | 1M: -0.14%) → flat | BELOW TREND.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Neutral overall: SPY CORRECTION (1W: -1.96% | 1M: +2.03%) vs TLT BELOW TREND (1W: -0.30% | 1M: -0.92%) → flat, and UUP BELOW TREND (1W: -0.96% | 1M: -1.90%) indicating a softer dollar backdrop.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Cyclicals/commodities and defensives showing pockets of strength: Energy XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.41% | 1M: +7.69%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND, Healthcare ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.06% | 1M: +8.38%), while Technology XLK CORRECTION (1W: -4.02% | 1M: +1.57%) shows short-term weakness; Style: mixed / no clear leadership.

5. US vs Global?
US equities softer this week: SPY CORRECTION (1W: -1.96% | 1M: +2.03%) while China FXI ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.32% | 1M: +3.60%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND — EM/East Asia showing relative strength versus US equity beta.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Concentrated risk-on in crypto and thematic: IBIT ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.83% | 1M: +10.34%) ↑ rising and ETHA ABOVE TREND (1W: +23.33% | 1M: +20.87%) ↑ rising, while small-cap IWM CORRECTION (1W: -1.92% | 1M: +1.32%) is softer.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Precious metals leadership: GLD ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.09% | 1M: +9.53%) ↑ rising and SLV ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.02% | 1M: +14.35%) ↑ rising; industrial metals softer with CPER CORRECTION (1W: -1.25% | 1M: +0.25%).

8. Energy Trend?
Energy rally intact: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.41% | 1M: +7.69%) and BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.54% | 1M: +4.03%) ↑ rising, while natural gas UNG RECOVERY (1W: +0.40% | 1M: -5.57%) shows short-term bounce.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
Confirmed: Commodities/energy and precious metals trade ABOVE TREND (GLD, SLV, XLE). MAJOR Divergence detected across core ETFs — SPY CORRECTION, XLK CORRECTION and Financials CORRECTION (Financials 1W: -2.64% | 1M: +1.08%) — suppresses strong directional bets.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor exposure to XLE (1W: +4.41% | 1M: +7.69%) and precious metals GLD (1W: +4.09% | 1M: +9.53%) / SLV (1W: +6.02% | 1M: +14.35%) showing strength; reduce exposure to Technology XLK (1W: -4.02% | 1M: +1.57%) and monitor SPY (1W: -1.96% | 1M: +2.03%) until divergence resolves; bonds and credit remain neutral/flat.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: XLE (1W: +4.41% | 1M: +7.69%) ABOVE TREND; GLD (1W: +4.09% | 1M: +9.53%) ABOVE TREND; XBI (1W: +4.16% | 1M: +7.41%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: XLK (1W: -4.02% | 1M: +1.57%) CORRECTION; Utilities XLU (1W: -0.61% | 1M: -4.70%) BELOW TREND.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: GLD (1W: +4.09% | 1M: +9.53%) ABOVE TREND, SLV (1W: +6.02% | 1M: +14.35%) ABOVE TREND, BNO (1W: +7.54% | 1M: +4.03%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: CPER (1W: -1.25% | 1M: +0.25%) CORRECTION, UNG (1W: +0.40% | 1M: -5.57%) RECOVERY for now.

13. Key Levels?
Watch VXX ~20 for a shift in fear (VXX (1W: -2.19% | 1M: -10.95%) ↓ falling); HYG/LQD ratio near 0.80 as a tilt toward credit stress (HYG (1W: -0.29% | 1M: +0.54%) → flat | CORRECTION; LQD (1W: -0.46% | 1M: -0.14%) → flat | BELOW TREND); XLK vs Financials divergence (XLK (1W: -4.02% | 1M: +1.57%) CORRECTION vs Financials 1W: -2.64% | 1M: +1.08% CORRECTION) as a leadership pivot trigger.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive, with Energy and Precious Metals showing relative strength (XLE ABOVE TREND; GLD/SLV ABOVE TREND). Key risk is the MAJOR divergence across core ETFs—SPY/XLK/Financials in CORRECTION—which warrants selective positioning and close monitoring.
